title: Reproducing the geometric-inductive-bias account of grokking on modular arithmetic

original_idea.body: Reproducing the geometric-inductive-bias account of grokking (arXiv:2603.05228, public code) on a toy modular-arithmetic transformer; toggle architectural constraints and measure grokking onset.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Inductive bias bears on goal misgeneralization (an Open-Phil problem) but the chain to catastrophic risk skips steps.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Toy transformer on modular arithmetic with public code; accessible with standard tooling.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: grokking-time curves under architectural toggles, well-defined success.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Foundational inductive-bias question, public code, weak lab incentive; independent replication friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Tiny model trains in minutes on one GPU, but it does involve training.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of a paper with public code; largely an existing result.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Replication of a published result with available code.
